deficits.evidence: A grassy, sloping embankment runs directly from the road edge to the buildings; there is no paved or trodden path for pedestrians.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved footway along the left side, set back from the carriageway on the grassy slope.

deficits.evidence: The right side of the road is bordered by a guardrail and a grassy verge, with no visible path for pedestrians to walk on.
deficits.suggestion: Install a footway on the right side, separated from the road by the existing guardrail and a grass buffer.

deficits.evidence: No street lights are visible along the length of the road in any of the frames.
deficits.suggestion: Install a series of street lights along both sides of the road to improve visibility for all road users.

ratings.reason: The left side is a steep, grassy embankment with no path, making the deficit visible, but the slope makes the feasibility of a footway unclear.
The right side has a guardrail and a narrow verge with no path, so the deficit is visible, but the space for a new footway is unclear.
No street lights are visible in the frames, but the suggestion is a generic measure that could apply to any unlit road.
